faqs.a:
For the purposes of this chapter, the terms "park" and "public park" shall be defined
               to include any recreation facility located within the city, owned by either the city
               or the North Jeffco Metropolitan Park and Recreation District, including, but not
               limited to, swimming pools, tennis courts, ice rinks, basketball courts, pedestrian
               and bicycle paths, green belts, picnic facilities, lawns and gardens.
(Code 1960, § 17-35; Code 1981, § 22-1)
